Introduction
This document describes the regular maintenance that has to be done for 
 HRSG P.I.( 
 differential 
 pressure indicator switches) and the interval of 
 each item of maintenance
The first draft is initiated by eng. Hany elokda and eng. Mahmoud derar ,and tested by eng. Bahaa abd 
 elwahab, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by 
 eng. Mohamed el sherif, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC 
 quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of 
 Nubaria PS and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality head 
 sector
Manufacturer | Quantity | Tag No. | Model | Range | Service Disc.
Rosemount | 4 | DISP(700,...etc | PCS45S4BB1B7P-TAG | 0-1 Bar | Water
Rosemount | 12 | DISP(0040,300,001B,...etc | PCS45S4BB7B7P-TAG | 0-0.7 Bar | Steam&Water
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment 
 must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses)
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged 
 on the work place, safety rope around the work place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Hand pump
Blower & brushes
Cleaning fluids such as freon - TF 
 chlorothene
Work to be 
carried out
Inspection and 
maintenance of P.I.
Make calibration procedures to The Pressure Indicator.
Check gauge filled 
 with Glycerin.
Check the contact of the switch is good
Indicator Cleaning.
Close the work permit.
